item.title: Gov. Abbott Announces $149 Million Cybersecurity Grant To Texas Tech University
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — Gov. Greg Abbott announced that the Governor’s Public Safety Office has awarded $149 million to Texas Tech University to support development of an electromagnetic pulse testing site and cybersecurity infrastructure enhancements.The investment is aimed at strengthening efforts to safeguard critical infrastructure across Texas and the United States through expanded research and security initiatives. Learn More Here.

item.title: Crash Shuts Down Intersection at Bryant, Avenue N
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A two-vehicle crash Thursday afternoon has shut down the intersection of Bryant Boulevard and Avenue N.The crash occurred just after 1 p.m. and is causing all northbound traffic on Bryant to be redirected. Southbound traffic has been reduced to two lanes. Traffic on Avenue N is unable to cross over Bryant. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State Baseball to Host 2026 Lone Star Spring Break Camp
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The Angelo State Rams will host its three-day 2026 Lone Star Spring Break Camp beginning Monday, March 16, at Foster Field at 1st Community Credit Union Stadium.The camp is open to players ages 8-13 and costs $150. Instruction will cover the fundamentals of throwing, hitting and fielding and will be led by head coach Kevin Brooks and current members of the Rams baseball team. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State Rambelles Play Final Home Games this Weekend
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Angelo State will close out the home portion of its 2025-26 regular season this week, bringing an eight-game winning streak into matchups against Lubbock Christian and Midwestern State at the Junell Center–Stephens Arena.The Rambelles host Lubbock Christian at 5:30 p.m. Thursday for Fiesta Night before facing Midwestern State at 1 p.m. Saturday. Learn More Here.

item.title: Abilene Police Searching for Suspect in First Homicide of Year
item.description: ABILENE, TX — Abilene law enforcement is searching for a suspect after the city’s first homicide of the year early Thursday.At about 5:15 a.m., police responded to the 3300 block of Sherry Lane in north Abilene for a report of an injured person. Learn More Here.

item.title: Veribest Shooting Victim Critical but Stable, Sheriff's Office Says
item.description: Update from last night's shooting incident near Veribest: Investigators have confirmed that the victim from last night's shooting sustained a minimum of three gunshot wounds. The victim remains hospitalized and is currently listed in critical but stable condition. Deputies and investigators continue to actively work the case. The suspect, Gerardo Santos, remains in custody in the Tom Green County Jail under a $200,000.00 bond. Learn More Here.

item.title: Texas Musician Tristan Roberson: Building a Large Audience One Stage at a Time
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Frisco, Texas native Tristan Roberson is the 18-year-old country singer-songwriter who’s turning daily hustle into real momentum — and San Angelo fans get a front-row seat this weekend.Roberson sat down for an interview just last night and opened up about his journey from bedroom TikTok videos to packed Texas honky-tonks, the stories behind his songs, and the breakout awards that capped his explosive 2025.
